explanation:
The soil test shows a critical deficiency in Nitrogen (N) while Phosphorus and Potassium levels are adequate. Urea is a highly concentrated nitrogenous fertilizer that will promote rapid vegetative growth and leaf greening.

Field Application Tips: Apply in split doses (basal and top-dressing) during the vegetative stage. Avoid applying when the soil is dry or waterlogged to minimize volatile loss. Mix with dry soil before broadcasting.

A balanced depletion of primary macronutrients (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium) is detected. This balanced formulation will restore overall macronutrient levels across all growth stages.

Field Application Tips: Can be applied through foliar spray or fertigation. Best applied during the early growth and flowering stages for uniform nutrient absorption.
